description:
Our team has now lived through a few levels, and after clearing the random pixel level, the heroes arrive in a jungle level that is rotting. Spike & Sprout and the Swarms have been poisoned and turned into zombies. It’s up to them to find a way through the chaos and survive this Night of the Undead Swarm Zombies.... Swarmbies (That’s Banana’s joke)
